purpose: Native mixed element geometry semantics only; no CFD timesteps or linear solves
source_of_nodes: Previous P2_CURVED_GEOMETRY_SAMPLES.npz, both affine and curved variants; no new meshing/projection

scales.H: maximum corner-to-corner distance of each retained cell
scales.u: H for u=x-x0 or (x-x0,-(y-y0),0); H^2 for axial quadratic; 1 for diagnostic general reference polynomial
scales.p: 1 Pa for pressure=0.3 + (z-z0)/H; general physical-pressure diagnostic uses gradient (1,2,3)/H
scales.continuity_residual: H^2*u_scale; explicitly avoids dividing by near-zero divergence-free residual
scales.local_matrix: norm_inf(reference), with pressure/velocity row blocks separately compared

fields: A: u=x-x_corner3, p=0.3+(z-z0)/H; exact G=I, div=3
B: u=(x-x0,-(y-y0),0), same axial pressure; exact G=diag(1,-1,0), div=0
C: u=(0,0,(z-z0)^2), same axial pressure; representable on these curved cells because z geometry remains affine
P: u=0, general physical linear pressure at corners; momentum pressure residual isolation
R: deterministic general nodal velocity/acceleration/body force for P1 and affine P2 regression

pressure_representation_contract.common_transform: grad_x p_h = J_geom^-T sum_i P_i grad_xi lambda_i
pressure_representation_contract.exact_physical_linear_test: p=0.3+(z-z0)/H is exactly representable for both retained cells since wall projection moves x/y only; verify this before testing
pressure_representation_contract.general_physical_linear_negative_control: p=c0+c.x generally pulls back to a quadratic on curved P2 geometry; P1 corner interpolation cannot reproduce it exactly. Record approximation error separately and never count it as a geometry-transform failure or hide it
pressure_representation_contract.quadratic_velocity_contract: General physical quadratic exactness on affine cells is inherited, not rerun; curved cells test representable axial quadratic and independent reference-basis/chain-rule values

reference: FP64 NumPy independent centered geometric Jacobian/inverse/metric and Hessian chain rule, fed into retained native fluid_3d_m/c using identical quadrature/coefficients; separate direct continuity and pressure-only weak-form integrals
P1_gate: Same validation executable contains unmodified TET4/P1/P1 branch; original production object, trace-only rebuild, patched build, repeated outputs compared
baseline_gate: Reproduce both previous curved Rp mismatches and pressure transform defect, while affine control is roundoff
boundary_gate: Native TRI6 normal/traction fixtures plus mixed weak-Dirichlet pressure trace audit; if same mapping defect remains, MIXED_CURVED_BOUNDARY_ASSEMBLY_BLOCKED and no next CFD recommendation
